pr.title: ui(cockpit): wire runtime renderer primitives to IA package
pr.body:
## Summary
- add deterministic local-only Cockpit runtime renderer primitives for the accepted IA package contract
- load package proof/index artifacts with provenance and fail-closed blockers
- implement Safe Action preflight and receipt primitives without runtime execution

## Strict scope
- no final screens
- no Claude Design upload
- no runtime action execution
- no T4 remote mutation
- no live service adapters

## Governance state
safe_for_claude_design: NO
READY_FOR_CLAUDE_DESIGN: not approved

## Validation
See closeout proof for command outputs and exit codes.

## Residual risks and downstream packets
- T4 remains blocked until a remote-mutation policy packet exists
- Settings/Admin per-row tier mapping remains owned by TP-DMX-COCKPIT-SETTINGS-RUNTIME-001
- Unknown/Drift Queue full surface remains owned by TP-DMX-COCKPIT-UNKNOWN-DRIFT-001
- inventory regeneration remains a separate packet

steps.task: Inspect repo authority, accepted package artifacts, and current Cockpit runtime surfaces before implementation.
validation: Package branch and accepted HEAD are verified.
Root authority absences are marked UNKNOWN.
Cockpit runtime files and tests are inspected before editing.

steps.task: Implement deterministic package loading, render model, Safe Action preflight, and receipt primitives without execution.
validation: Loader fails closed on missing package inputs and parses accepted proof/index files.
Render model preserves exactly five top-level modes and four global surfaces.
Safe Action preflight refuses blocked, unknown, stale, drifted, unsafe, and policy-missing candidates.

steps.task: Wire the guarded Cockpit CLI runtime-render flag and keep default Cockpit rendering fail-closed.
validation: Runtime render requires an explicit flag and package directory.
CLI snapshot output preserves Claude Design blocked state.
No shellout, network, live service, DB, PM, ConPort, dope-memory, or remote mutation code is introduced.

steps.task: Add focused unit tests and local proof artifacts for the runtime-render primitive layer.
validation: Boundary greps pass without forbidden positive claims.
Proof output is written only under the allowed runtime-render proof/out paths and is labeled as proof, not runtime authority.
